0x000835.en: 「With my skills now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008A6.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x00092E.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A57.en: 「So this is as far as I go...!?」

0x000A8F.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000B93.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny at all...」

0x000BE7.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to withdraw...」

0x000D38.en: 「This is as far as I go... the rest is up to you.」

0x000D6A.en: 「Damn it...!@ So this is the end!」

0x000DE4.en: 「No good, took too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000E31.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E6F.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000EB6.en: 「To think the Granzon would be shot down...」

0x000F61.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who falls like a star... I'm ejecting!」

0x001018.en: 「Owowow... I give up, my calculations were off.」

0x00109D.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x001151.en: 「I'm sorry. The rest is up to you.」

0x001186.en: 「Damn! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x001272.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still green...!」

0x0012C0.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0013AA.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013E8.en: 「Well, well, this is the end for me.」

0x001417.en: 「I can't go on any further. I'll take my leave now, if you'll excuse me.」

0x0014A2.en: 「Was I careless...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x0014F0.en: 「N-no, not in a place like this...!」

0x001608.en: 「Ejecting now...@ Ngh...! So much for looking cool...」

0x0016C6.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001896.en: 「A-all hands!@ Make abandoning ship your top priority...!!」

0x00190A.en: 「Guess I've got no choice but to retreat...!」

0x0019B1.en: 「Not good, I'm afraid.@ It seems General Kirkus began moving the moment@ Prince Terius fled.」

0x001A4A.en: 「Right now, Kirkus's main force is linking up with other units@ and marching on the royal capital.」

0x001ACD.en: 「So sitting back to watch the coronation cost us dearly.@ If we'd returned right then...@ No, if we'd left the Hagane in the capital...」

0x001B7E.en: 「Maybe Ahmed's real aim was to tie us down@ back there...」

0x001BF5.en: 「Brother, Masaki... it's pointless to dwell on that now.」

0x001C3E.en: 「But isn't General Kirkus feeling the pressure too?@ If the truth about the coronation gets out,@ he's the one who'll be in trouble.」

0x001CE3.en: 「They'd deployed units on every front to push the@ Shutednias army out of Langran.」

0x001D69.en: 「So they can't possibly mass their full strength@ around the capital all at once...」

0x001DD1.en: 「Right...@ Kirkus's army is forced into a short, decisive fight,@ so they don't have time to gather numbers.」

0x001E5B.en: 「Our situation is much the same.@ I only hope General Ort can hold out@ until we get back to the capital...」

0x001F06.en: 「Even if we make it, it'll be just us and the general's unit@ against Kirkus's whole main force...」

0x001F89.en: 「If the full Steel Dragon Squadron were assembled,@ we might manage somehow...」

0x001FFA.en: 「When you're short on numbers, all you can do@ is cover it with individual effort.」

0x002093.en: 「The tuning isn't fully finished yet,@ but it's operational.」

0x002181.en: 「Grant Ing permission to sortie.@ In the R-Blade Custom.」

0x002225.en: 「Ing... you mean the one with amnesia?」

0x002275.en: 「It's too dangerous, Captain.@ No matter how well he scored in the simulator,@ sending out someone whose past is unknown...」

0x00231A.en: 「It's a gamble.@ But to win against Kirkus's main force, we have to@ commit anything that can add to our fighting strength.」

0x0023D1.en: 「If combat makes him regain his memory...@ isn't there a chance he'll turn against us?」

0x00245A.en: 「I'll keep him on a leash.@ If the worst happens, I'll take responsibility.」

0x0024CF.en: 「Does Ing... get a say in this?」

0x002509.en: 「Yes.@ Sending out someone with no will to fight@ can only end one way.」

0x00256F.en: 「So it's a kind of shock therapy.@ The same tactic Major Ingram once used...」

0x002615.en: 「Very well.@ If Ing agrees, you may send him out.」

0x0026C1.en: 「No, I'll do it.@ I owe you all for saving my life...」

0x002730.en: 「If there's something I can do@ in a crisis like this...」

0x0027B4.en: 「Think it over carefully.@ If... on the off chance something happens, then...」

0x00281C.en: 「...I'm prepared for that.@ I'll pilot the R-Blade Custom.」

0x00288B.en: 「Hnn...!@ Are these the only units we have left...!」

0x0028D2.en: 「General Ort, you can no longer stop us.@ I won't mince words. Surrender.」

0x00294C.en: 「His Highness charged me with holding the fort...!@ I'll stop you if it costs me my life!」

0x0029E5.en: 「...Seems you've got spine, but you'll die for nothing.」

0x002A2B.en: 「I've no intention of surrendering to traitors!@ If even a sliver of hope remains, I won't@ give up!」

0x002ABE.en: 「Hope... a chance, you say? As if such a thing...」

0x002B05.en: 「General Kirkus!@ The Hagane is charging in from one o'clock!」

0x002B5B.en: 「The opposite side! Then, into the capital...!」

0x002C91.en: 「Yes.@ I've got the hang of handling this machine.」

0x002D0C.en: 「Ing, if anything goes wrong with you,@ I'll force your machine to a halt.」

0x002DB8.en: 「...You don't need to push to the front line.@ Support the Hagane.」

0x002E30.en: （I can't die while my memory's still gone...@ still not knowing who I am...）

0x002EA4.en: 「...So the Hagane shows up at this moment.@ A trial sent by heaven?」

0x002F06.en: 「Withdraw your troops, General Kirkus.@ Any more fighting is meaningless.」

0x002F59.en: 「You say that with a blade at the throat@ of the royal capital?」

0x002FC1.en: 「You don't want Langran in chaos either.@ Like you, General, I want to end this@ battle as soon as possible.」

0x003057.en: 「Then you should withdraw your own troops@ and hand the capital over to us.@ And we ask that the prince renounce his claim to the throne.」

0x003105.en: 「Who the hell do you think you are!?」

0x003133.en: 「General Kirkus... I know the truth of the coronation.@ It's only a matter of time before it comes to light.」

0x0031DE.en: 「My, playing dumb on a grand scale.@ Is that a Kirkus army specialty?」

0x003252.en: 「We know that the Prince Terius who attended@ that coronation was an impostor.」

0x0032CF.en: 「And what proof do you have to say such a thing?」

0x003312.en: 「...You know it too, General.@ That we made contact with the real Terius.」

0x00337D.en: 「Well now... I have no memory of that.」

0x0033E8.en: 「So no matter what, you won't stand down?」

0x003428.en: 「Just so. There's nothing left but to settle this here.」

0x003465.en: 「Hmph... you've got nerve, Kirkus.@ Quite different from the man you used to be.」

0x0034C4.en: 「I'm surprised myself, that I had this much talent.@ A capable minister in peace, a cunning hero in chaos.」

0x003556.en: 「Capable minister, my foot. You were a do-nothing.」

0x003593.en: 「Now is the time when only strength can show the way.@ Even branded an arch-traitor, I will unite Langran...@ no, all of <La Gias> - by force.」

0x003661.en: 「That is the surest way to bring peace@ to this world.」

0x0036BA.en: 「That ambition's too big for you!@ How many people are you willing to@ sacrifice to pull it off!?」

0x00377E.en: 「If you have the will, come to my side.@ And together, let us fight for the peace@ of all La Gias.」

0x003811.en: 「Someone up on the surface said the very same thing.@ Same goal, but the problem was the method@ used to reach it.」

0x0038F6.en: 「Oh, your so-called cause is easy enough to grasp.@ But that's exactly why it's dangerous... you see.」

0x003988.en: 「Yes... your cause is a hair's breadth from ambition.」

0x0039C5.en: 「And you know what they say... haste makes waste.」

0x003A0E.en: 「It seems talking further is pointless after all.@ All units, commence attack.」

0x003A73.en: 「<Einst>... I'll settle this here and now.」

0x003AAF.en: 「You... so you were with the Kirkus army.」

0x003B82.en: 「He was the squad leader under Colonel Ban,@ head of Neue DC... he also fought in the battle@ against the Einst at Langley.」

0x003C36.en: 「I see, so that's why he hates the Einst...」

0x003C76.en: 「Yuuki... you traitor.@ Forgetting Colonel Ban's kindness and@ crawling to the Steel Dragon Squadron...!」

0x003D00.en: 「Captain Oleg...@　With Colonel Van dead, Neue DC has no cause left.」

0x003D59.en: 「And what good does it do to drag a surface war@　down here into La Gias?!」

0x003DC1.en: 「Wherever we stand, all who side with@　the Einst and the Federation deserve to die!」

0x003E2F.en: 「Sorry, but I've got no time to humor@　your grudges...!」

0x003E94.en: 「Kirkus... you went too far.@　Time to pay the price for that ambition, right here!」

0x003F08.en: 「Come, then!@　Your deaths will prove my cause to the world!」

0x003F6D.en: 「This is no time to hold our forces back...!@　Launch every remaining unit!」

0x003FE4.en: 「So that's the last of them!@　This fight's decided, Kirkus!」

0x00403D.en: 「Nonsense!@　No battle is over till it's over!」

0x00408D.en: 「Then I'll bring down the curtain right now!」

0x00412C.en: 「...He couldn't see reality,@ in more ways than one...」

0x0041E1.en: 「But I will not give up! Not until my ideal is real!@　We'll meet again!」

0x0042DC.en: 「Kirkus has lost his power and his cause.@　So the men who followed him will probably...」

0x0043AF.en: 「Remember this, Yuuki! And you, Einst!@　I will never accept that you exist!」

0x00448B.en: 「No... if General Kirkus lost,@　we were ordered to surrender to you.」

0x00451B.en: 「The general also told us this...@　'You've already repaid what you owed me.'」

0x00466E.en: 「That sleepy old fool actually pulled this off!@　I'll give him credit for that much!」

0x0046EF.en: 「Cybuster... to think a Machine God@　could change the world this much.」

0x004751.en: 「Then there's no reason I can't do the same!」

0x004788.en: 「General, power exists to be restrained!@　Swinging it around wildly makes you no better than a child!」

0x0047FF.en: 「In a crisis like this,@　someone must rule by strength!@　Why can't you understand that?!」

0x004880.en: 「So you'll do whatever it takes, eh,@　General Kirkus! But you're a sore loser!」

0x0048FD.en: 「Zamzeed's new pilot.@　So the Machine Gods won't take@　my side after all...!」

0x004981.en: 「Princess Xenia, forgive my rudeness.@　Please, make your escape.」

0x0049E0.en: 「Save it, General Kirkus!@　When I heard you'd raised your banner,@　I actually had some hope for you!」

0x004A73.en: 「Now that I'm a Machine God pilot too,@　I can't overlook what you're doing, General Kirkus!」

0x004AE1.en: 「The Sword King Zeorut's daughter...@　Talent or not, I can't lose@　to some green little girl!」

0x004B71.en: 「Highness, if you won't embrace my cause,@　then I'll have your life.」

0x004BD3.en: 「I can't afford to fall yet,@　General Kirkus...!」

0x004C2F.en: 「But you are not fit to be the new king,@　Highness. And no one knows that better@　than you yourself, do they?」

0x004CDD.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Langran Province, Capital

0x004D3F.en: 「...Kirkus's units across the region@　are surrendering to us one after another.」

0x004DA4.en: 「However, Kirkus's whereabouts are unknown,@　and we're still searching. The Shutedonias army@　has made no major moves.」

0x004E52.en: 「I see... Then begin preparing@　the reconstruction work across Langran...@　and about Bagonia...」

0x004EDC.en: 「Brother, you look pale.@　You've hardly slept lately, have you?@　Won't you rest a little?」

0x004FB4.en: 「I-I'm fine. There's no time to rest now...」

0x004FF7.en: 「You mustn't! Your body is precious, Highness.@　Please don't overexert yourself.」

0x00505F.en: 「I'll contact the doctor and have him come here.」

0x00509F.en: 「Never mind that... you take Duraxil and...」

0x0050DF.en: 「This is no time to be worrying about that!」

0x005122.en: （There's no time... The time left to me...@　is running out...）
